desc.v: This field is used to configure how long SCL remains low in master mode, in I2C module clock cycles.
This field is used to configure the time to hold the data after the falling edge of SCL, in I2C module clock cycles.
This field is used to configure how long SDA is sampled, in I2C module clock cycles.
This field is used to configure the SCL_FSM's waiting period for SCL high level in master mode, in I2C module clock cycles.
This field is used to configure how long SCL remains high in master mode, in I2C module clock cycles.
This field is used to configure the time between the falling edge of SDA and the falling edge of SCL for a START condition, in I2C module clock cycles.
This field is used to configure the time between the rising edge of SCL and the falling edge of SDA for a RSTART condition, in I2C module clock cycles.
This field is used to configure the delay after the STOP condition, in I2C module clock cycles.
This field is used to configure the time between the rising edge of SCL and the rising edge of SDA, in I2C module clock cycles.
The maximum time that SCL_FSM remains unchanged. It should be no more than 23.
The maximum time that SCL_MAIN_FSM remains unchanged. It should be no more than 23.
This is the enable bit for
7-bit
general call addressing.
This is the enable bit to check if the R/W bit of
10-bit
addressing is consistent with the I2C protocol.
This is the enable bit for slave to send data automatically.
Synchronization bit.
This bit is used to reset the SCL_FSM.
This is the enable bit for I2C bus arbitration function.
This field controls APB_CLK clock gating. 0: APB_CLK is gated to save power; 1: APB_CLK is always on.
This bit is used to control the order to receive data. 0: receives data from the most significant bit; 1: receives data from the least significant bit.
This bit is used to control the order to send data. 0: sends data from the most significant bit; 1: sends data from the least significant bit.
Set this bit to start sending the data in TX FIFO.
Set this bit to configure the I2C controller as an I2C Master. Clear this bit to configure the I2C controller as a slave.
This bit is used to configure the ACK value that need to be sent by master when
I2C_RXFIFO_CNT
has reached the threshold.
This bit is used to select the sampling mode. 0: samples SDA data on the SCL high level; 1: samples SDA data on the SCL low level.
Configures the SDL output mode. 0: Open drain output; 1: Direct output
Configures the SDA output mode. 0: Open drain output; 1: Direct output
This is the enable bit for timeout control.
This field is used to configure the timeout value for receiving a data bit in I2C_SCLK clock cycles. The configured timeout value equals 2^
I2C_TIME_OUT_VALUE
clock cycles.
This field is used to enable the
10-bit
addressing mode in master mode.
When the I2C controller is in slave mode, this field is used to configure the slave address.
The control enable bit of FIFO pointer in non-FIFO mode. This bit controls the valid bits and TX/RX FIFO overflow, underflow, full and empty interrupts.
Set this bit to reset TX FIFO.
Set this bit to reset RX FIFO.
When this bit is set to 1, the byte received after the I2C address byte represents the offset address in the I2C Slave RAM.
Set this bit to enable APB non-FIFO mode.
The watermark threshold of TX FIFO in non-FIFO mode. When
I2C_FIFO_PRT_EN
is 1 and TX FIFO counter is smaller than
I2C_TXFIFO_WM_THRHD
I2C_TXFIFO_WM_INT_RAW
bit is valid.
The watermark threshold of RX FIFO in non-FIFO mode. When
I2C_FIFO_PRT_EN
is 1 and RX FIFO counter is bigger than
I2C_RXFIFO_WM_THRHD
I2C_RXFIFO_WM_INT_RAW
bit is valid.
This is the filter enable bit for SDA.
This is the filter enable bit for SCL.
When a pulse on the SDA input has smaller width than the value of this field in I2C module clock cycles, the I2C controller ignores that pulse.
When a pulse on the SCL input has smaller width than the value of this field in I2C module clock cycles, the I2C controller ignores that pulse.
The clock switch bit for the I2C controller.
The clock selection bit for the I2C controller. 0:
XTAL_CLK
RC_FAST_CLK
The denominator of the divisor's fractional part.
The numerator of the divisor's fractional part.
The integral part of the divisor.
The power down enable bit for the I2C output SDA line. 0: Not power down; 1: Power down. Set
I2C_SDA_FORCE_OUT
and
I2C_SDA_PD_EN
to 1 to stretch SDA low.
The power down enable bit for the I2C output SCL line. 0: Not power down; 1: Power down. Set
I2C_SCL_FORCE_OUT
and
I2C_SCL_PD_EN
to 1 to stretch SCL low.
Configures the pulses of SCL generated in master mode. Valid when
I2C_SCL_RST_SLV_EN
is 1.
When the master is idle, set this bit to send out SCL pulses. The number of pulses equals
I2C_SCL_RST_SLV_NUM
Set the level of the ACK bit when
I2C_SLAVE_BYTE_ACK_CTL_EN
is set.
The enable bit for slave to control the level of the ACK bit.
Set this bit to clear SCL clock stretching.
The enable bit for SCL clock stretching. 0: Disable; 1: Enable. The SCL output line will be stretched low when
I2C_SLAVE_SCL_STRETCH_EN
is 1 and one of the four stretching events occurs. The cause of stretching can be seen in
I2C_STRETCH_CAUSE
Configures the time period to release the SCL line from stretching to avoid timing violation. Usually it should be larger than the SDA steup time.
This field indicates the status of the state machine used to produce SCL. 0: idle; 1: start; 2: falling edge; 3: low; 4: rising edge; 5: high; 6: stop.
This field indicates the status of the state machine. 0: idle; 1: address shift; 2: ACK address; 3: receive data; 4: transmit data; 5: send ACK; 6: wait for ACK.
This field stores the number of data bytes received in RAM.

The cause of SCL clock stretching in slave mode. 0: stretching SCL low when the master starts to read data; 1: stretching SCL low when TX FIFO is empty in slave mode; 2: stretching SCL low when RX FIFO is full in slave mode.
This field represents the number of data bytes to be sent.
When the I2C controller is in slave mode, and the address sent by the master matches the address of the slave, this bit is at high level.
0: the I2C bus is in idle state; 1: the I2C bus is busy transferring data.
When the I2C controller loses control of the SCL line, this bit changes to 1.
When in slave mode, 0: master writes to slave; 1: master reads from slave.
The received ACK value in master mode or slave mode. 0: ACK; 1: NACK.
The received data in I2C slave mode.
This is the offset address of APB bus writing to TX FIFO.
This is the offset address of the I2C controller reading from TX FIFO.
This is the offset address of the I2C controller receiving data and writing to RX FIFO.
This is the offset address of the APB reading from RX FIFO.
This field is used to read data from RX FIFO, or write data to TX FIFO.
